findings.summary: Removing the verifier ancestry check lets an older substitute assessment clear a finding that the bot re-reports on a later commit, so a reverted fix can pass the gate merely because the substitute chain carries forward its old fixed disposition.

disposition.reason: Accepted limitation, spec §5.6 (David, 2026-11-03): a fix that a later commit reverts can still pass. The operator ruled on 2026-11-10 to revert 5df29d8 and accept this case rather than patch it, because that fix broke the rebase escape for fresh substitutes (Codex P2s at ee247f1); the rewritten-commit gap is tracked in #94.
